items.name: Set.seq_eq_image2

items.name: Set.mem_image2
items.type: {α : Type u} {β : Type v} {γ : Type w} {f : α → β → γ} {s : Set α} {t : Set β} {c : γ} : c ∈ Set.image2 f s t ↔ ∃ a ∈ s, ∃ b ∈ t, f a b = c
